Name: Ashwini
Description: The first Nakshatra representing beginnings, healing, and speed.

Name: Bharani
Description: Represents transformation, responsibility and the cycle of life.

Name: Krittika
Description: Associated with the Pleiades star cluster and symbolizes purification.

Name: Rohini
Description: Associated with growth, fertility and abundance.

Name: Mrigashira
Description: Represents curiosity, exploration and searching.

Name: Ardra
Description: Associated with transformation, storms and renewal.

Name: Punarvasu
Description: Represents renewal, optimism and restoration.

Name: Pushya
Description: Known for nourishment, learning and prosperity.

Name: Ashlesha
Description: Represents wisdom, intuition and mystery.

Name: Magha
Description: Associated with ancestors, leadership and authority.

Name: Purva Phalguni
Description: Represents creativity, relationships and enjoyment.

Name: Uttara Phalguni
Description: Associated with friendship, agreements and generosity.

Name: Hasta
Description: Represents skill, craftsmanship and intelligence.

Name: Chitra
Description: Associated with beauty, design and architecture.

Name: Swati
Description: Represents independence, flexibility and learning.

Name: Vishakha
Description: Represents determination and achievement.

Name: Anuradha
Description: Associated with friendship, devotion and cooperation.

Name: Jyeshtha
Description: Represents leadership, responsibility and protection.

Name: Mula
Description: Associated with roots, transformation and research.

Name: Purva Ashadha
Description: Represents confidence, victory and optimism.

Name: Uttara Ashadha
Description: Associated with leadership and lasting success.

Name: Shravana
Description: Represents listening, learning and knowledge.

Name: Dhanishta
Description: Associated with prosperity, rhythm and community.

Name: Shatabhisha
Description: Represents healing, research and discovery.

Name: Purva Bhadrapada
Description: Associated with wisdom, sacrifice and transformation.

Name: Uttara Bhadrapada
Description: Represents patience, stability and compassion.

Name: Revati
Description: The final Nakshatra symbolizing prosperity, safe journeys and completion.
